title: Realization identifies the integral geometric comparison diagram
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $f:X=X_0\times_{k_0}k\to Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$ its base change, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $g_T=\operatorname{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for $T=X,Y$, with $\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q$ geometric Frobenius [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius]. Work on the small pro-etale sites.

Put $R_T=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,T}=\varprojlim_m(\mathcal O_E/\ell^m)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathcal C_T=D^b_{ctf}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ be the derived-complete integral constructible finite-Tor category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $r_T=\operatorname{red}_T$ for simultaneous derived reduction and $L_T=R\varprojlim_m$ for total derived inverse limit from actual varying-coefficient towers, restricting each level to $R_T$-modules before realization [det-sp-normalized-equivalence]. On the tower categories use $F_\bullet=Rf_{!,\bullet}\dashv G_\bullet=f^!_\bullet$, $H_\bullet=f_\bullet^*(-)(d)[2d]$, purity $\Gamma_\bullet:H_\bullet\simeq G_\bullet$ and counit $\varepsilon_\bullet$ [det-sp-tower-gluing, det-sp-tower-gamma]. Let $P_\bullet,Q_\bullet$ be pullbacks along $g_Y,g_X$; define $B_\bullet:P_\bullet F_\bullet\simeq F_\bullet Q_\bullet$ by the retagged square and $e_\bullet$ as the transpose of $P_\bullet(\varepsilon_\bullet)B_\bullet^{-1}$ [det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. Let $b_\bullet:Q_\bullet H_\bullet\simeq H_\bullet P_\bullet$ include the canonical Tate comparison [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists]. Use completed integral pullbacks $P=Lg_Y^*$, $Q=Lg_X^*$ and $H=Lf^*(-)(d)[2d]$ [def-pur-integral-derived-operations].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms
$$P L_Y\simeq L_Y P_\bullet,\qquad Q L_X\simeq L_X Q_\bullet$$
on normalized constructible towers, compatible with the reconstruction units $K\simeq L_Yr_YK$ and the corresponding units on $X$. The inverse-image equivalences along $g_T$ on completed module sheaves and on strict towers preserve K-injective complexes; the displayed comparisons agree with the maps obtained from ordinary inverse limit on such resolutions using the coefficient isomorphism $g_T^{-1}R_T\simeq R_T$.

Under these comparisons, $F=Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}\simeq L_YF_\bullet r_X$, $G\simeq L_XG_\bullet r_Y$ and $H\simeq L_XH_\bullet r_Y$, with $G$ identified counit-preservingly with the integral exceptional adjoint [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower, det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. The integral purity $\gamma^H_{f,\mathcal O_E}=R\varprojlim\Gamma_\bullet\circ r_Y$ of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection], the integral unit and counit, the completed compact-support exchange $B=\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_!$ of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map] for the first Cartesian square of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius] (the integral exchange used in [def-pur-compact-support-transport]), and the integral pullback/tensor/shift/Tate comparison $b$ formed on strict reduction towers as in [def-pur-tate-datum] are respectively the realized tower maps $\Gamma_\bullet,\eta_\bullet,\varepsilon_\bullet,B_\bullet,b_\bullet$. The realization of $e_\bullet$ is the integral adjoint transpose of $P(\varepsilon)B^{-1}$. Thus these identifications intertwine the specified maps of the entire diagrams, as natural transformations in the integral derived categories.

proof.text: Choose the one strict tower presentation b,o,x with Laws by tower_shriek_levels. Obtain its section-normalized coordinates q by coordinates_realization. These are actual witnesses eliminated in Prop, not data chosen in a definition.

Apply geometric_smooth_reconstruction_setup to this presentation and the standing geometric Frobenius data. Obtain one compactification, its base change, a,hb,s, the two compatible smooth reconstruction packages, their unit equations, and invertibility of the tower exceptional mate. Derive all compactification instances using c.comm.

Use integral_geometric_reindexing_realization for both horizontal scheme isomorphisms. The module and fixed-ring tower equivalences in its reindexing predicates preserve K-injectives by the proved additive-equivalence preservation instance; this proves the fixed-ring injectivity fields directly. Retain the pullback/total-limit comparisons, their unit equations, and varying-ring K-injectivity.

Use integral_geometric_purity_realization relative to the smooth packages just obtained. It supplies precisely the two source models, canonical whole-tower Tate word and both normalized natural purity isomorphisms.

Use integral_geometric_support_realization to obtain the specified coefficient transport, support beta, CompletedExchange and its entire reduction equation. This step asserts no exceptional transpose equality.

Build image as NatIso.ofComponents of s.supportModel.imageComparison. The left_normalization equation identifies each hom with the adjunction transpose of s.supportComparison. Naturality follows from Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_square and naturality of that support comparison. Its normalization is reflexivity. The independent-right-adjoint field is exactly Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq_hom_counit.

Whisker the entire tower mate by red_Y, conjugating with source and target comparisons, and take preimageIso along the fully faithful whiskering by red_Xprime. Its hom component is definitionally the specified reconstructed map. The total-limit identity is the naturality equation of the normalization adjunction unit, rewritten using map_preimage and homEquiv_unit.

Identify this hom with the integral transpose by integral_geometric_transpose_identity and the support reduction equation. Assemble all fields of Diagram and introduce the existential witnesses of Result. No definition or requested normalization changes.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q116-4384f1e06 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS: I read the whole delivery. It is the first delivery of a Q150-created helper for the parent's Step 5. There is no re-split note and no new nodes, and the statement is unchanged against side-live. Source: main-20261015 sk-prop-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection(.proof); in its Bijections paragraph the unit and counit are R lim of the tower ones, and in its Purity paragraph γ^H is defined as R lim γ_•, which is what steps 5, 6 and 9 use. I checked every step against the cited statements. Step 1: retagging a'_T=Spec(γ)a_T, the same as in def-pur-tate-datum, makes g_T k-linear for det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc; X and Y are Noetherian; étale-origin witnesses come from constructible-origin. Step 2: ℓ=uϖ^e with e≥1, and cofinal Roos restriction with φ(m)=em, whose hypotheses (exact countable products) hold. Step 3: the K-injective transpose argument is genuinely elementary. Step 4: G_uR lim≅R lim G_u and Lu*_comp≅G_u from completed-reduction-reindexing, plus the integral clause of the automorphism stage equivalence. Step 5: direct-image tower, the adjunction bijection and uniqueness of right adjoints. Steps 6-7: substitution and shift realize H and b; the Tate datum is the lim of the μ_{ℓ^r} maps. Step 8: strict-integral normalization v_•=r_• applies to the Cartesian first Frobenius square with g'=g_X, together with semilinear exchange reindexing. Step 9: adjunct-counit identity. Two advisories, not faults. (a) The R lim-of-finite integral Rf_! of prop-coef and R f̄_*j_! are identified by direct-image-tower(2); det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc already fixes this convention. (b) The varying-ring site-isomorphism mate is the reindexing comparison by standard mate calculus. No duplicate found by rg -L.
